_note: Fictional example. The person, the employers and the school do not exist.
facts: 5 years of professional experience in software and data engineering (Jul 2019 to Aug 2024).
rewording_notes: The Kafka work at Quillmere (ql4) was a pilot on one carrier's feed and was not moved to production. Always say so.
The dbt migration (ql2) covered the 38 finance models only. Do not write 'the warehouse' or 'all models'.
Mentoring (ql7) was informal. Do not write 'managed' or 'led a team'.

bullets.text: Built and maintained 14 Apache Airflow DAGs that load shipment, carrier and billing data from 6 source systems into Snowflake every night.
Migrated 38 finance models from hand-written SQL scripts to dbt, with tests on every model. Monthly close data preparation went from 3 days to 1 day.
Added Great Expectations checks to the 5 highest-traffic tables. In their first year the checks caught 23 bad loads before analysts saw them.

Ran a three-month pilot that ingested one carrier's tracking events through Apache Kafka into PostgreSQL, about 1.2 million events per day with a median delay under 40 seconds. The pilot was not moved to production.
Cut the nightly load window from 4 hours to 2.5 hours by partitioning the two largest tables and running independent DAGs in parallel.
Wrote the on-call runbook for the data platform and took part in a 4-person on-call rotation.
Mentored two junior engineers through code review and weekly pairing sessions.
Developed Python and Java services for the member statements system, which serves about 52,000 members.
Rewrote the nightly statement export as a set of SQL jobs on PostgreSQL, cutting its run time from 95 minutes to 20 minutes.
Built a reconciliation report that compares ledger totals with the core banking export and flags mismatches over $50.
Set up GitHub Actions to run unit tests and linting on the team's 9 repositories.
Built a Python tool that reads public GTFS-Realtime transit feeds and maps average bus delays by route and hour. It processes about 300,000 records per day on one small cloud instance.
Packaged it with Docker and a GitHub Actions workflow. 11 outside contributors have opened pull requests.
Wrote a command-line checker in Python that validates CSV bank exports against a schema and reports row-level errors.
Covered the parser with 140 unit tests in pytest.
Senior capstone: a route-planning service for the campus shuttle, built by a team of four.
